test.create_query: CREATE TABLE agg_in_order_partial_key (a UInt64, b UInt64, c UInt64, nb Nullable(UInt64), nc Nullable(UInt32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO agg_in_order_partial_key SELECT number, number * 7, number * 11, if(number % 7 = 0, NULL, number * 13), if(number % 7 = 0, NULL, toUInt32(number * 17)) FROM numbers_mt(800000)
test.query: SELECT a, b, count() FROM agg_in_order_partial_key GROUP BY a, b SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT DISTINCT a, b, c FROM agg_in_order_partial_key SETTINGS optimize_distinct_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, nb, count() FROM agg_in_order_partial_key GROUP BY a, nb SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, nc, count() FROM agg_in_order_partial_key GROUP BY a, nc SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT DISTINCT a, nb FROM agg_in_order_partial_key SETTINGS optimize_distinct_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, count() FROM agg_in_order_partial_key GROUP BY a SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
WITH number % 4000000 AS k1, (number * 7) % 4000000 AS k2 SELECT k1, k2, count() FROM numbers_mt(10000000) GROUP BY k1, k2 SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 0 FORMAT Null
